2094. Reversing a 5-Digit Integer and Summing It With the Original

80

Hard

Problem Statement
Read a 5-digit integer, reverse its digits, and print both the reversed number and the sum of the original number and its reverse.
Description
Read a 5-digit integer num and store its original value in a separate variable, since num itself will be modified while extracting digits. Extract all five digits using % and / repeated five times, and rebuild them in reverse order to get the reversed number. Print the reversed number, then print the sum of the original number and the reversed number.
input_spec: A single line containing a 5-digit integer num (10000 ≤ num ≤ 99999).
output_spec: Print the reverse of num on the first line, then the sum of num and its reverse on the second line.
